decoding: temperature 0, reasoning off, max 4 interaction rounds, context size 8192

variants.name: oracle_sender_qwen_receiver
variants.primary_outcome: Qwen Agent 1 exact global prefix segment among episodes where it received the correct oracle subtotal before submission

frozen_predictions: If model scale is a material cause of v0.9 failures, Qwen3-8B will improve exact receiver output under the oracle sender, sender subtotal fidelity, or both relative to the paired Qwen3-4B result.

If both role outcomes remain near v0.9 despite twice the parameter count, model scale alone is insufficient to explain the failure; inspect role prompts, arithmetic decomposition, and tool/task interaction before any language comparison.
No protocol superiority is predicted or tested.
metrics: message syntax, delivery, receipt, and subtotal value fidelity
backend tokens, wall time, and rounds
limits: same 12 task seeds as v0.8/v0.9; no new held-out evidence
one greedy inference per task and role variant
